name: Saint Jean Groupe Societe anonyme
summary: Saint Jean Groupe Société anonyme, through its subsidiaries, operates in the agri-food sector in France. The company offers ravioles, quenelles, fresh pasta, and delicatessen products under the Saint Jean, Royans, Ravioles de Romans, Quenelles La Royale, and Comptoir du Pastier brand names. It is also involved in various agricultural activities; and the management of real estate land located in the Crau plain. The company was formerly known as Sabeton SA. The company is headquartered in Dardilly, France.
